questions.q: [NSMO of KSA — Riyadh Finals] A function \( f: \mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z} \) satisfies \[ f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y) + 2xy \quad \forall x, y \in \mathbb{Z}, \] together with \( f(1) = 2 \) (with additive core \( g(x) = f(x) - 1x^2 \) plotted). Compute \( f(7) \).
questions.answer: Define the auxiliary function \( g(x) = f(x) - 1x^2 \). Substituting into the functional equation cancels the \( 2xy \) cross-term, so \( g(x + y) = g(x) + g(y) \) on \( \mathbb{Z} \). Since \( g(1) = f(1) - 1 = 1 \), \( g(x) = 1x \) and \( f(x) = 1x^2 + 1x \). Thus \( f(7) = 1(7^2) + (1)(7) = 56 \).

questions.q: [NSMO of KSA — Riyadh Finals] Let \( v_3(N) \) denote the exponent of the prime \( 3 \) in the prime factorization of \( N \). Using the Lifting The Exponent (LTE) Lemma, compute \[ v_3\!\left(7^{27} - 1^{27}\right). \]
questions.answer: Verify the LTE hypotheses: \( p = 3 \) is an odd prime, \( 3 \nmid 7 \), \( 3 \nmid 1 \), and \( 3 \mid (7 - 1 = 6) \). Therefore, \[ v_3(7^{27} - 1^{27}) = v_3(7 - 1) + v_3(27) = 1 + 3 = 4. \]

questions.q: [NSMO of KSA — Mawhiba IMO Camp] Over all positive real numbers \( a, b, c > 0 \), find the exact minimum value of the cyclic expression \[ \frac{2a + 1b + 1c}{b + c} + \frac{2b + 1c + 1a}{c + a} + \frac{2c + 1a + 1b}{a + b}. \]
questions.answer: Splitting each fraction gives \[ 2\left(\frac{a}{b + c} + \frac{b}{c + a} + \frac{c}{a + b}\right) + 1 + 1 + 1. \] By Nesbitt's Inequality (proved by adding \( 1 \) to each fraction and applying Cauchy–Schwarz / Titu), \( \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{a}{b + c} \ge \frac{3}{2} \) with equality at \( a = b = c \). Hence the minimum is \( 2\cdot\frac{3}{2} + 3 = 6 \).

questions.q: [NSMO of KSA — Mawhiba IMO Camp] Over all positive real numbers \( a, b, c > 0 \), find the exact minimum value of the cyclic expression \[ \frac{2a + 2b + 2c}{b + c} + \frac{2b + 2c + 2a}{c + a} + \frac{2c + 2a + 2b}{a + b}. \]
questions.answer: Splitting each fraction gives \[ 2\left(\frac{a}{b + c} + \frac{b}{c + a} + \frac{c}{a + b}\right) + 2 + 2 + 2. \] By Nesbitt's Inequality (proved by adding \( 1 \) to each fraction and applying Cauchy–Schwarz / Titu), \( \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{a}{b + c} \ge \frac{3}{2} \) with equality at \( a = b = c \). Hence the minimum is \( 2\cdot\frac{3}{2} + 6 = 9 \).
